FN-8PI1FF2-1
FISCAL NOTE
Hose Bill 269
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Rep. Colvin
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/23/2024
Hose Bill 269 as introduced could increase or decrease sales, use, and lease tax receipts to the
Education Trust Fund or State General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the
difference in utilization of the tax exemptions of certain aircraft and parts provided under
current law and the utilization of the exemptions as provided by this bill.
Page 1

FN-8PI1FF2-2
FISCAL NOTE
Hose Bill 269
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Rep. Brock Colvin
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/24/2024
Hose Bill 269 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education could increase or
decrease the state portion of the sales, use, and lease tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund or
State General Fund by an undetermined amount through fiscal year 2029 dependent on the
difference in utilization of the tax exemptions of certain aircraft and parts provided under
current law and the utilization of the exemptions as provided by this bill.
This bill could also decrease sales, use, and lease tax receipts of county and municipal
governments by an undetermined amount, if the respective local governments adopt an
exemption from taxation pursuant to this bill.
